newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar falls on foreign fund outflows.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar falls on foreign fund outflows.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar edged lower against its U.S. counterpart in early Wednesday trade on outflows of foreign equity funds, dealers said.
After 60 minutes, or 0200 GMT, the local unit was at T$27.808 against Tuesday's T$27.775 close. Turnover through dealers was an active US$82 million.
Dealers said local greenback demand remained strong despite the U.S. dollar's recent weakness against the yen.
"The overseas factor has not had a major impact on Taiwan's market recently. It looks like the Taiwan dollar is still in a downtrend," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A trading range of T$27.78-82 was seen for Wednesday.
